title: Efficient expectation value estimation for quantum circuits via extended stabilizer frameworks and adaptive variance estimation
summary: Classical simulability of quantum circuits plays a central role in characterizing and quantifying quantum computational advantage. Typically, the presence of non-Clifford gates introduces an exponential runtime overhead for classically estimating expectation values of observables. In this work, we introduce an efficient simulation framework that integrates the sum-over-Clifford method with quasi-probability-based stabilizer simulation to directly estimate expectation values.
